note: A model reading of kind found, checked against its note by a fixed rule (shared/engine-ts/src/found.ts, correctFoundKind). When the note says an object was found (found a, an, some, the, his, their, or a possessive her, then a known object) and nothing says the person was found (a subject or person word, a word for the person's state or the response to them, or one of the profile's names), the reading becomes a clue, with its item and feature read from the note, and the reason is shown. Any other reading is returned unchanged. parserKind is what the phones' rules parser (ReportParser.kind) gives the same note, so a platform can check its parser agrees.
reason: Read as a clue: an object was found, not the person.
